caption:
Here's what the reference sheet won't tell you.

It has areas, volumes, the Pythagorean theorem and special right triangles. It does NOT have slope, the quadratic formula, the vertex formula, the circle equation or SOH-CAH-TOA.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: What the SAT reference sheet won't tell you, and what to memorize.

youtube.title: What's on the SAT Math Reference Sheet
youtube.description: The SAT reference sheet gives area, volume, Pythagorean theorem and special right triangle facts, but not slope, the quadratic formula, the vertex formula or the circle equation.
